create_calculate_runner_subclass: create a subclass of CalculateRunner that implements calculate and write_results abstract methods
run_calculate_runner: run the CalculateRunner to execute calculations using an ASE calculator and save results to a directory
load_state_from_checkpoint: load a previously saved calculation state from a checkpoint directory to resume interrupted jobs
implement_calculate_method: implement the abstract calculate method in a CalculateRunner subclass to perform ASE-based calculations
implement_write_results_method: implement the abstract write_results method in a CalculateRunner subclass to save calculation results to file
